name: ASPSCR1 tether for SLC2A4, UBX domain containing

function.text: ASPSCR1 encodes tether containing UBX domain for GLUT4. Annotated molecular activities include methyltransferase regulator activity. It participates in ERAD pathway and glucose homeostasis.

germline.text: No constitutional disease assertion was retrieved in the reviewed GenCC snapshot; this does not exclude a germline association.

somatic.text: Reported somatic alteration contexts include Alveolar soft part sarcoma; TFE3-rearranged renal cell carcinoma. The alteration class and exact variant must be assessed in the disease context.
